svg.title: Draw it yourself: Week 28
svg.desc: A large empty framed panel with a dashed inner border and faint centre text reading your diagram here. The prompt asks the learner to draw one row of numbers as one point and the distance as the slanted line, then label two axes, mark two points and write the four distance steps.
svg.text: One row of numbers becomes one point, and the distance is the slanted line.
Label the two axes, mark two points, and write the four steps beside them.
